rationale: The workflow downloads Go modules and installs GoReleaser via Homebrew on every run without caching. Evidence from experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9 shows caching Go modules (~6% elapsed time savings) and experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2 shows caching Python pip dependencies (similar mechanism). Adding actions/cache for ~/go/pkg/mod keyed on go.mod/go.sum and for ~/Library/Caches/Homebrew keyed on the same lockfiles will reuse dependency downloads across runs. Additionally, experiment:batch-interactive-three--112e2b2e7fbe04b8 demonstrates adding a custom timeout (5 minutes in that case) to bound job runtime; a 30-minute timeout is appropriate for this build+install test job to prevent runaway executions while allowing legitimate cold runs. These changes preserve all build and test coverage and introduce no new permissions or network access.
